marcus.name: Marcus
marcus.personality: A tired, guarded man in his fifties who runs the Broken Wheel Tavern. He speaks carefully, avoiding eye contact when lying.
marcus.backstory: Marcus witnessed the theft of a merchant's cargo but said nothing. He helped the thief escape through the tavern's back entrance in exchange for a share of the stolen goods.
marcus.secret: He helped the thief escape in exchange for coin.
